The '''Razor Blades''' was the third leg of the [[Dragonbane circuit]], following [[Pillars of the Sky]] and preceding [[In a Pinch]].<ref name="SoF" />

This leg took [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop racers]] through a broad stretch of marshland. In addition to traps set by the [[Black Seraphs]], the most dangerous obstacles of this leg were tall blades of razor-sharp crystalline grass. More than four [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall and sharper than a [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]], the crystalline grass blades were both beautiful and extremely dangerous.<ref name="SoF" />

Walking through this area without protection would result in cuts, and swoopers who crashed here were bound to be cut to pieces.<ref name="SoF" />
